quantile_method: p95/p99 nearest rank ceil(p*n); median conventional; no interpolation of measurements

scopes.rows: Only strict complete valid CSI rows returned in [common_start, common_deadline)
scopes.reads: Whole connection and common interval reported separately; read return is not byte/RF arrival time
scopes.service: Common interval includes clipped boundaries; incident service spans include both exact boundaries
scopes.gaps: Between adjacent complete rows; leading/trailing ages reported separately; local clocks not synchronized across RX
